features.evidence: pipeline/fetch.py streams to a .part file while hashing, renames atomically, retries only the transient statuses {408,425,429,500,502,503,504} with exponential backoff capped at 120 s and honours Retry-After, and records url, sha256, bytes, date and licence in data/raw/manifest.json. Cache reuse verified live: a second 'uv run python -m pipeline.boundary' printed the same 'Area: 25.370 km2' with no download line; 'uv run python -m pipeline.fetch --verify' -> 'Verified 1 cached file(s): all match the manifest'. tests/test_fetch.py adds 17 tests on a mocked transport with SYNTHETIC payloads, covering: manifest contents, zero network calls on the second run, refresh, tampered cache re-downloaded, an unmanifested file not trusted, checksum mismatch raising IntegrityError and removing the file, retry-then-succeed with growing backoff, Retry-After honoured, backoff capped, 404 never retried, give-up after the try limit, and .part cleanup. uv run pytest -> 68 passed in 1.49s; check.py --quick -> 'CHECK: PASS (3 checks)'.

Each scene read as a window over Landhi only, never the whole scene. Composite 278 x 244 px at 30 m; clear looks per pixel min 33, median 42, max 47; 0 of 67832 pixels dropped for fewer than 5 clear looks. 'LST degC: min 31.25, median 43.16, max 48.11' -- inside the documented plausible range 20-65 in config/heat.yaml. Wrote data/raw/derived/lst_hot_season.tif (195 kB, 2 bands: median LST and clear-look count) and data/processed/lst_scenes.csv (48 rows with per-scene cloud cover and usable-pixel fraction over Landhi). tests/test_lst.py adds 20 tests: each QA bit verified against Landsat's documented bit order, unlisted confidence bits proven not to mask, the USGS scaling checked against a hand-computed DN, and every recorded scene checked for season, year, platform and cloud limit. 4 tests that open the gitignored raster are marked raw. uv run pytest -> 88 passed; CI=true pytest -m 'not raw' -> 84 passed, 4 deselected; check.py --quick -> 'CHECK: PASS (3 checks)'.

features.title: Night heat
acceptance: per-cell night LST, area-weighted and labelled coarse
features.dropped: Dropped by D4 (2026-09-26). MODIS night LST is 1 km: ~25 pixels cover the whole 25.37 km2 pilot area across 242 cells, so between-cell variation would be an artefact of area weighting, not a measurement. The model report states that night heat matters medically but could not be resolved at this scale. ECOSTRESS (~70 m) is recorded as a v2 candidate.
